preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 2 and 2000.
The maximum allowed running time k must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: if tot > k then 'no solution' else 'valid points'
postconditions.description: If the running time tot exceeds k, output 'no solution'. Otherwise, output valid points.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(points)) == n for points in zip(xi, yi))
all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x in xi) and all(-10**9 <= y <= 10**9 for y in yi)
postconditions.description: The coordinates of each point must satisfy -10^9 <= xi, yi <= 10^9.
